detail: Vegorama Punjabi Angithi Limited has completed its listing on the BSE SME for an Initial Public Offering comprising a fresh issue and an offer for sale by a selling shareholder, aggregating to ₹38.38 crore. Legacy Law Offices advised and acted for Punjabi Angithi, Selling Shareholder Mr Deepak Chadha, and the Book Running Lead Manager Corporate Makers Capital Ltd, on this IPO. The transaction team consisted of Roopali Chaturvedi (Senior Partner), Pradyun Chakravarty (Partner), Naman Anand (Counsel) and Gayatri Bansal (Associate). Punjabi Angithi is principally a cloud kitchen and takeaway service provider, focusing on delivering high-quality vegetarian North Indian and other cuisines…
